home.tagline: Push six of your opponent's marbles off the board to win.
home.rules_link: Never played? The rules take two minutes
home.account_note: A bot game needs no account. Sign in and every game you play is kept, online and off.

auth.prompt_body: Play under your own name. Every win is kept.

errors.username_taken: That name is already taken. Try another one.
errors.username_invalid: Names are 3 to 20 characters, using letters, numbers, dots and underscores.
errors.invalid_credentials: That name and password don't match. Check both and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

auth.credentials_warning:
Name and password can't be reset.
Lose them and the account goes too.

profile.picture_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP. It is cropped to a square.
profile.upload_failed: That picture didn't upload. Try again.

play.title: Play
play.online_hint: Against another player, under your name.
play.offline_hint: Against a bot, or two of you on this device.
play.bot_hint: Against a bot, at the strength you pick.
play.local_hint: Two of you, taking turns on this device.
